moodys.citation_text: Moody's held UPMC at A2 stable across the window. UPMC has been at A2 with stable outlook for many years; affirmed multiple times.

sp.citation_text: S&P held UPMC at A stable throughout window per UPMC investor disclosures.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch held UPMC at A stable. Outlook revised positive 2022 then back to stable post-2023 weak results.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch revised UPMC outlook to positive on strong COVID-era performance and operating income recovery. Outlook later revised back to stable after 2023 results.

outcome_class_rationale: UPMC held A2/A/A across the window with Fitch outlook revised UP to positive in 2022. Record $23.1B revenue in 2020 with 12% growth and $836M operating income; insurance division growth. UPMC was a clear outperformer through COVID era thanks to integrated payer-provider model.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: UPMC CY2020 record $23.1B operating revenue (up 12% from $20.6B), $836M operating income (3.6% margin), $9.9B cash and investments. Insurance Services Division grew 11%.

ma_events_2021_2022.rationale: UPMC continued integrating prior acquisitions (Pinnacle, Susquehanna, Western Maryland completed Feb 2020 just before snapshot). No major new M&A in 2021-2022 — focus on integration.
